soft.overview:
eveBB is fast, light, user-friendly forum software: fewer features, faster pages, and readable code. It is the modernized continuation of FluxBB (abandoned upstream in 2021) - fully schema-compatible with FluxBB 1.5, so existing FluxBB boards can switch in place - rebuilt for modern PHP.

Highlights: PHP 8.1-8.4 support, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL or a single SQLite file (no database server needed), bcrypt passwords with transparent migration of legacy hashes, hardened CSRF protection and login throttling, a visual (WYSIWYG) editor writing standard BBCode, a responsive default style, and a built-in one-click updater that verifies the SHA-256 checksum of every release before installing it. A plugin system adds polls, topic tags, badges, two-factor authentication, social sign-in, webhooks, scheduled backups and more - each installed from the admin panel as a single zip upload.
soft.features:
• Fast and light - runs comfortably on inexpensive shared hosting
  • Modern PHP (8.1-8.4)
  • MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL or SQLite (single file, no DB server)
  • Built-in one-click updater with SHA-256 verification (GPG-signed releases)
  • Visual editor (SCEditor) writing standard BBCode
  • Responsive default style; installable styles and plugins (single zip upload)
  • Drop-in continuation of FluxBB 1.5 - existing boards switch in place
  • Free and open source, GNU GPL v2 or later
